description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the Schedule of the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1448/27 of 09.06.2006 which specifies the Faculties & the Departments of the University of Colombo
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically, an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an official order issued under statutory authority (Section 27(1) of the Act) that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Colombo. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending existing legislation and university governance structures rather than government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
